title: Correlating Charge-Storage Kinetics, Quantum Capacitance, and Surface Charge Density in Bi2O2S: An Experimental-DFT Study
title_zh: Bi2O2S 中电荷存储动力学、量子电容和表面电荷密度的关联：实验 DFT 研究
summary: 了解层状电极材料中的电荷存储需要将电化学动力学与电极积累电子电荷的固有能力区分开来。在这里，使用电化学测量和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算研究了相纯 Bi2O2S，以建立这种关系。循环伏安法、恒电流充放电和电化学阻抗谱揭示了强烈的速率依赖性电荷存储响应，在 1 A g-1 时比电容为 866 F g-1。扫描速率依赖性给出的平均 b 值为 ~ 0.61，而 Dunn 分析表明，扩散依赖性过程主导着电荷存储响应。
abstract: Understanding charge storage in layered electrode materials requires distinguishing electrochemical kinetics from the intrinsic ability of the electrode to accumulate electronic charge. Here, phase-pure Bi2O2S was investigated using electrochemical measurements and density functional theory (DFT) calculations to establish this relationship. Cyclic voltammetry, galvanostatic charge-discharge, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy revealed a strongly rate-dependent charge-storage response, with a specific capacitance of 866 F g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹. The scan-rate dependence gave an average b-value of ~ 0.61, while Dunn analysis showed that diffusion-dependent processes dominate the charge-storage response. DFT calculations further demonstrated that surface modification alters the electronic charge-storage ability of Bi2O2S. The calculated quantum capacitance increased from 493.14 (:μ:Fcm⁻²) for the pristine surface to 638.75 (:μ:Fcm⁻²) following OH adsorption. Surface charge densities of 513.46 and 506.76 (:μ:C:cm⁻²) were obtained for K-top and K-hollow configurations, respectively. Experimental surface charge densities approached the DFT-derived range at higher current densities, whereas larger deviations at lower current densities indicate additional contributions from electrolyte-mediated and Faradaic processes. These results establish an experimental-DFT framework for relating rate-dependent electrochemical charge storage to the intrinsic electronic charge-accumulation behaviour of Bi2O2S.

title: From nonmagnetic to magnetic: A 2D semiconductor with electrically tunable magnetism
title_zh: 从非磁性到磁性：一种具有电可调磁性的2D半导体
summary: 新加坡国立大学（ NUS ）的研究人员与瑞士、捷克共和国和德国机构的科学家合作，展示了一种将磁性引入非磁性二维（ 2D ）半导体的方法，随后使用电压控制其磁性。该研究结果发表在《科学进展》杂志上，为研究原子薄材料中的电可控磁性建立了一个新的平台，对未来的自旋电子技术具有潜在的影响。
abstract: Researchers from the National University of Singapore (NUS), in collaboration with scientists from institutions in Switzerland, the Czech Republic and Germany, have demonstrated a way to introduce magnetism into an otherwise nonmagnetic two-dimensional (2D) semiconductor and subsequently control its magnetic properties using an electrical voltage. The findings, published in Science Advances, establish a new platform for investigating electrically controllable magnetism in atomically thin materials, with potential implications for future spintronic technologies.

title: Magnetic sculpting transforms single-source fields into predetermined shapes with mathematical precision
title_zh: 磁性雕刻以数学精度将单源场转换为预定形状
summary: 磁场是从核磁共振扫描仪和粒子加速器到原子钟和未来量子计算机等技术中不可见但必不可少的组成部分。这些应用中的每一种都需要具有特定形状和特性的磁场。如今，创建这种量身定制的磁场需要研究人员和工程师为每个单独的应用设计专门的、经过精心优化的磁体或大型线圈系统，这是一个复杂且资源密集型的过程。
abstract: Magnetic fields are invisible yet essential components in technologies ranging from MRI scanners and particle accelerators to atomic clocks and future quantum computers. Each of these applications requires magnetic fields with specific shapes and properties. Today, creating such tailored magnetic fields requires researchers and engineers to design specialized, carefully optimized magnets or large systems of coils for each individual application—a complex and resource-intensive process.

title: Synergistic Effect of Cu Doping and g-C 3 N 4 /BiVO 4 Heterojunction for Boosted Visible-Light Photocatalytic Degradation of RhB
title_zh: Cu掺杂和g-C 3 N 4 /BiVO 4 异质结的协同效应促进RhB的可见光光催化降解
summary: 半导体异质结的构建与元素掺杂相结合是优化光催化材料光学性能的可行且有效的策略。在这项工作中，通过简单的合成路线成功制备了 Cu 掺杂的 g-C3N4/BiVO4 复合光催化剂。表征证实 BiVO4 纳米颗粒均匀生长在 g-C3N4 纳米片上，其中 Cu 物质与三嗪环配位形成接触良好的异质结界面。在可见光照射下，优化的Cu/g-C3N4/BiVO4复合材料在60分钟内实现了92.01%的罗丹明B（RhB）降解效率，显着优于纯g-C3N4、BiVO4和Cu/g-C3N4。
abstract: The construction of semiconductor heterojunctions combined with elemental doping is a feasible and efficient strategy to optimize the optical properties of photocatalytic materials. In this work, Cu-doped g-C3N4/BiVO4 composite photocatalysts were successfully fabricated via a facile synthetic route. Characterization confirmed that BiVO4 nanoparticles uniformly grow on g-C3N4 nanosheets, with Cu species coordinating with the triazine ring to form a well-contacted heterojunction interface. Under visible-light irradiation, the optimized Cu/g-C3N4/BiVO4 composite achieved a rhodamine B (RhB) degradation efficiency of 92.01% within 60 min, significantly outperforming pure g-C3N4, BiVO4, and Cu/g-C3N4. In addition, the composite maintains excellent cyclic stability after four repeated degradation tests, with only a slight decrease in catalytic activity. Radical trapping experiments verify that ·O2- and h⁺ are the dominant active species responsible for RhB photodegradation. To further clarify the intrinsic enhancement mechanism at the atomic level, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed. The theoretical results intuitively reveal the electronic structure modulation and interfacial charge transfer behavior induced by Cu doping and heterojunction construction, confirming the establishment of a Type-II charge transfer pathway. The synergistic effect between Cu doping and heterojunction structure effectively broadens the visible-light absorption range and suppresses the recombination of photogenerated carriers. This work clarifies the structure-activity relationship of modified g-C3N4-based composites via combined experimental and theoretical investigations, providing a reliable reference for the design and preparation of high-efficiency visible-light photocatalysts.

title: A Framework Based on hp-Finite Elements for Solving the Time-Harmonic Maxwell Equations
title_zh: 基于hp有限元求解时谐麦克斯韦方程组的框架
summary: 由于双旋度算子的不确定性、寄生模式的存在以及大频率下求解振荡解的高计算成本，时谐麦克斯韦方程的精确计算解仍然是计算电磁学中的一个核心挑战。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种 HP 有限元方法来求解时谐麦克斯韦方程的双旋度算子，以及由此产生的振荡模式。该方法使用 Engquist-Majda 吸收边界条件和自适应 hp 细化来有效处理无界域和复杂的场行为。为了补充分析，基于残差估计和使用局部平滑度指标的手动预细化之间的自动选择，开发了完整的自适应实现。
abstract: The accurate computational solution of the time-harmonic Maxwell equations remains a central challenge in computational electromagnetics due to the indefinite nature of the double curl operator, the presence of spurious modes, and the high computational cost of resolving oscillatory solutions at large frequencies. In this work, we develop a hp-finite element method to solve the double-curl operator of time-harmonic Maxwell equations, as well as the resulting oscillatory modes. The approach uses Engquist-Majda absorbing boundary conditions and adaptive hp-refinements to efficiently handle unbounded domains and complex field behavior. To complement the analysis, a complete adaptive implementation is developed based on residual error estimation, and automatic selection between hand p-refinement using a local smoothness indicator. This provides a practical realization of the proposed adaptive strategy. We present stability analysis and establish a priori and a posteriori error estimates that ensure optimal decay of the discretization error. The numerical results confirm mathematical rigor of the formulation and demonstrate that the balance between hand p-refinements yields optimal convergence with respect to the degrees of freedom. This method provides a substantial improvement in accuracy and efficiency compared to conventional finite element for time-harmonic electromagnetic fields. One can show [4] that the solution of problem (8) coincides with that of (7).

title: Comparison of calcined and sulfonated α-hematite as catalysts for biodiesel production from cow tallow
title_zh: 煅烧和磺化α-赤铁矿作为牛脂生产生物柴油催化剂的比较
summary: 将由废铁屑中的α-赤铁矿制备的锻铁 (CI) 和磺化锻铁 (SCI) 催化剂用于利用牛脂生产生物柴油进行比较。该研究报道了在 900 °C 下煅烧 CI，然后用浓硫酸处理 CI 以获得 SCI。 X 射线衍射给出报告的 CI 晶粒尺寸为 1.237 nm，SCI 晶粒尺寸为 1.944 nm。
abstract: Calcined iron (CI) and sulfonated calcined iron (SCI) catalysts prepared from alpha-hematite derived from waste iron filings were compared for biodiesel production from cow tallow. The study reports calcination at 900 °C for CI and subsequent treatment of CI with concentrated sulfuric acid to obtain SCI. X-ray diffraction gave reported crystallite sizes of 1.237 nm for CI and 1.944 nm for SCI. Brunauer-Emmett-Teller analysis showed a higher specific surface area for SCI (337.13 m²/g) than for CI (294.72 m²/g), together with a larger pore volume (0.201 versus 0.152 cm³/g), a narrower pore width, and a smaller reported pore diameter. Both catalysts were evaluated at methanol-to-oil ratios of 3:1, 4:1, 5:1 and 6:1 in a 100 mL glass reactor on a digital magnetic stirrer with yield calculated as (mass of biodiesel produced / mass of cow tallow used) × 100. The highest yield for both catalysts occurred at 5:1, reaching 60.953% with CI and 62.159% with SCI. Across all tested ratios, CI had the higher reported arithmetic mean yield (51.79% versus 49.36%), largely because SCI showed a pronounced decrease at 4:1. The evidence therefore supports SCI as the higher-performing catalyst at the reported optimum ratio, while CI appears more consistent across the tested methanol-to-oil range. Because the source manuscript contains conflicting statements about some preparation conditions and does not provide numerical fatty acid methyl ester composition data, these points are not reconstructed or supplemented.

title: Generative Quantum Search for Combinatorial Optimization: Learning Shallow Quantum Samplers for Classically Refined Solution Subspaces
title_zh: 用于组合优化的生成量子搜索：学习经典细化解决方案子空间的浅量子采样器
summary: 我们将生成量子本征解算器 + 量子选择配置交互 (GQE+QSCI) 架构从量子化学移植到组合图优化。我们的框架 GQO+QSS（生成量子优化 + 量子选择搜索）遵循相同的原理：ML 生成电路程序，量子采样器生成位串，经典恢复修复并将其扩展到受限子空间，经典求解器在该子空间内找到最佳值。
abstract: We port the Generative Quantum Eigensolver + Quantum-Selected Configuration Interaction (GQE+QSCI) architecture from quantum chemistry to combinatorial graph optimization. Our framework, GQO+QSS (Generative Quantum Optimization + Quantum-Selected Search), follows the same principle: ML generates circuit programs, quantum samplers produce bitstrings, classical recovery repairs and expands them into a restricted subspace, and a classical solver finds the optimum within that subspace. We formalize the key quantity as the recovery-basin mass pr(qθ,G) = Prx∼qθ [x ∈ Ar(G)], where Ar(G) = x : Er(R(x))∩X∗(G) ̸= ∅ is the preimage of the optimal set under repair R and r-flip expansion Er. Under B independent shots, success probability becomes Psuccess = 1 − (1 − pr)B. The quantum-benefit question reduces to: does pr(qquantum,G) > pr(qclassical,G)? We test this on MaximumWeighted Independent Set (MWIS) with a preregistered, frozen protocol. All 150 ground truths are certified with CBC + brute-force verification. Exact recovery-basin masks are enumerated for all n ≤ 20 instances. Nine samplers are compared on a held-out test set: uniform, greedy, simulated annealing, tabu search, multi-start local search, Metropolis, warm-start QAOA, oracle QAOA, and a matched learned classical policy. Key findings:  1. Tabu search dominates at all sizes (pr = 0.82–0.94), followed by simulated annealing. All quantum samplers and the learned classical policy lose to both at every problem size under the frozen test protocol.  2. Oracle QAOA loses to SA under fair evaluation: With random QAOA configurations (not per-instance optimized), oracle QAOA achieves pr = 0.014 at n = 28 vs SA’s 0.088. The earlier positive result (pr = 0.185 vs 0.130) required per-instance best-of-50 configuration selection—an oracle upper bound, not a deployable method.  3. Learned classical policy matches oracle QAOA: A matched 140K-parameter classical policy achieves pr = 0.005–0.101, comparable to oracle QAOA’s 0.014–0.113. The quantum circuit’s proposal distribution provides no structural advantage over a matched learned classical model in this setting.  4. Recovery-basin masks reveal the phase structure: At r = 2, uniform-sampling Precover drops from 0.975 (n = 16) to 0.775 (n = 20) at B = 200, identifying the regime where sampler quality matters.  5. Hardware robustness without advantage: 136 cores on Piast-Q show 93.4% recovery consistency between QPU and simulator, but no basin-mass advantage.  This is a falsification study: Under rigorous, preregistered evaluation with matched learned baselines, shallow QAOA-derived proposal distributions do not outperform matched classical proposal models, and both lose to strong classical baselines (SA, tabu). The earlier positive oracle result was an artifact of per-instance configuration selection. We claim no quantum advantage.

title: Lateral photovoltaic effect in SiO2/TeO2/Bi2Te3/n-Si structure
title_zh: SiO2/TeO2/Bi2Te3/n-Si结构的横向光伏效应
summary: 研究了 SiO2/TeO2/Bi2Te3/n-Si 混合异质结构中的横向光伏效应 (LPE) 作为光波长、温度、照明位置和磁场的函数。使用热电子发射模型估计该结构的肖特基势垒高度为ΦB = 0.3 eV。在 λ = 1 µm 附近观察到 LPE 的显着变化，包括光电压极性的反转。这表明与 Si 衬底和 Bi2Te3 薄膜中载流子光生相关的两个主要光伏通道之间的转变。研究发现，与 Si 相关的贡献对磁场敏感，而与 Bi2Te3 相关的贡献几乎不受影响。
abstract: The lateral photovoltaic effect (LPE) in a SiO2/TeO2/Bi2Te3/n-Si hybrid heterostructure was investigated as a function of light wavelength, temperature, illumination position, and magnetic field. The Schottky barrier height of the structure was estimated to be ΦB = 0.3 eV using the thermionic emission model. A pronounced change in the LPE is observed near λ = 1 µm, including a reversal of the photovoltage polarity. This indicates the transition between two dominant photovoltaic channels associated with carrier photogeneration in the Si substrate and Bi2Te3 film. The Si-related contribution was found to be sensitive to the magnetic field, whereas the Bi2Te3-related contribution remains nearly unaffected. The magnetic-field effect on the Si-related LPE is attributed to interface states localized near the Bi2Te3/n-Si interface. These results demonstrate the coexistence of distinct photovoltaic channels in Bi2Te3/Si-based hybrid structures and provide insight into the mechanisms governing their photoelectric and magnetically sensitive response.

title: Multicomponent Magnetic Domain Walls in Rhombohedral Graphene
title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯中的多组分磁畴壁
summary: 磁序的空间纹理，例如磁畴壁和斯格明子，是磁性中的基本物体。在菱形多层石墨烯中，磁序涉及自旋和谷自由度，开启了新的空间纹理的可能性。在这里，我们通过对菱面体石墨烯谷不平衡四分之一金属相中的一维畴壁的微观研究来探索这种可能性。我们发现了两种不同类别的畴壁。一种类似于传统的磁畴壁，在两个块体状态之间局部旋转，而另一种本质上是多组分的，并探索在任一体域中都没有占据的状态。哪种纹理的实现是由间隔洪德耦合和自旋轨道耦合之间的竞争控制的，我们识别了实验特征来区分它们。
abstract: Spatial textures of magnetic order, such as domain walls and skyrmions, are fundamental objects in magnetism. In rhombohedral multilayer graphene, magnetic order involves spin and valley degrees of freedom, opening the possibility of qualitatively new spatial textures. Here, we explore this possibility through a microscopic study of a one-dimensional domain wall in the valley-imbalanced quarter-metal phase of rhombohedral graphene. We uncover two different classes of domain walls. One resembles a conventional magnetic domain wall, locally rotating between the two bulk states, whereas the other is intrinsically multicomponent and explores states that are not occupied in either bulk domain. Which texture is realized is controlled by the competition between intervalley Hund's coupling and spin-orbit coupling, and we identify experimental signatures to distinguish them. For a superconducting junction formed across the wall, we further show that the superconducting phase difference couples directly to the intervalley-coherent phase of the texture, allowing precession of this internal phase to generate a voltage. This mechanism provides an explanation for the resistive domain walls recently observed in chiral superconductors [arXiv2605.13303] and predicts accompanying magnetization oscillations that could be detected using GHz-frequency AC probes. Our theory establish a microscopic connection between multicomponent magnetic textures, their internal dynamics, and superconducting transport.

title: Orientation Mechanics and Kinetic Constraints of In-Situ Low-Field Magnetic Alignment in Vat Photopolymerization
title_zh: 还原光聚合中原位低场磁取向的取向机制和动力学约束
summary: 在槽光聚合 (VP) 过程中微填料的原位磁性排列提供了一种制造功能复合材料的途径，但电磁硬件改造引入了显着的空间、运动学和热学权衡。本技术说明评估了改装为基于商用液晶显示器 (LCD) 的 VP 打印机的低场亥姆霍兹线圈的操作边界。
abstract: In-situ magnetic alignment of microfillers during vat photopolymerization (VP) offers a route to fabricating functional composites, but electromagnetic hardware retrofits introduce significant spatial, kinematic, and thermal trade-offs. This technical note evaluates the operational boundaries of a low-field Helmholtz coil retrofitted to a commercial liquid crystal display (LCD)-based VP printer. Despite single-particle models predicting sufficient torque to overcome viscous drag, active-field operation (0.31- 0.40 mT ) yielded modest directional alignment (S2D=0.156±0.104, R2=0.60±0.26, across N=5 samples, 10 total region of interests (ROIs), 0.092 wt%  / 0.038 vol% ) compared to isotropic controls (S2D=-0.004±0.044, R2=0.45±0.15). This work delivers two key contributions: (1) it establishes that low-field conditions (0.31–0.40 mT) mark the lower sensitivity threshold required to initiate weak, statistically verifiable microscale directional bias above background noise, while quantifying the substantial field deficit relative to the ~15–50 mT needed for macro-scale functional anisotropy, and (2) it presents an analytical framework decoupling physical order parameters (S2D) from distribution curve fitting (R2), demonstrating that fit accuracy alone cannot confirm alignment. Primary performance bottlenecks-including fibre agglomeration, field magnitude deficits, and rapid particle sedimentation restricting printing to single layers-are quantified to provide critical engineering scaling criteria for future high-field magnetic additive manufacturing systems.

title: Substorm Triggering Processes During Different Phases of Geomagnetic Storms: A Case Study
title_zh: 地磁暴不同阶段的亚暴触发过程：案例研究
summary: 利用卫星和地面站的观测，我们研究了触发地磁风暴不同阶段发生的两个亚暴扩展阶段的可能机制。主要发现总结如下。对于在风暴开始和初始阶段发生的亚暴，能量存储过程主要受到增强的太阳风速和动压力的调节，而行星际磁场（IMF）的南转似乎是膨胀阶段开始的关键触发因素。对于风暴恢复阶段发生的亚暴，能量储存主要与IMF南转有关，而扩张阶段在IMF南转后经过一段时间延迟后开始。对这两个事件的详细分析表明，地磁风暴期间触发亚暴扩展的机制可能与孤立的非风暴亚暴期间的机制不同。
abstract: Using observations from satellites and ground-based stations, we investigate the possible mechanisms triggering the expansion phases of two substorms that occurred during different phases of a geomagnetic storm. The main findings are summarized as follows. For the substorm occurring during the storm commencement and initial phase, the energy storage process is primarily modulated by enhanced solar wind speed and dynamic pressure, whereas a southward turning of the interplanetary magnetic field (IMF) appears to be a key trigger for the onset of the expansion phase. For the substorm occurring during the storm recovery phase, energy storage is primarily associated with the southward IMF, while the expansion phase begins after a time delay following the southward turning of the IMF. Detailed analysis of these two events suggests that the mechanisms triggering substorm expansion during geomagnetic storms may differ from those operating during isolated, non-storm substorms. In contrast, previous studies have identified northward turnings of the IMF as an important indicator of expansion-phase onset in substorms under non-storm conditions. These results provide new insight into the relationship between geomagnetic storm evolution and substorm development in Earth’s magnetosphere.
